'''Frodomar City''' is allegedly the [[hometown]] of [[Ritchie]]. It is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kanto]], and is only mentioned in the [[dub]]. It is also possible that this [[city]] does not exist, and that Ritchie was lying so as not to alter [[time]], considering that the only time the place was mentioned was in ''[[HS13|Celebi and Joy!]]'', where Ritchie was transported several years into the past by {{p|Celebi}}.
